<h1 id="kavita">Kavita v0.9.1.16</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Kavita provides a set of APIs authenticated via an Auth Key passed in the `x-api-key` header. Generate an Auth Key under User Settings → Manage Auth Keys, paste it into the Authorize panel, and all Try It requests will include it. Assume all fields of a payload are required unless marked optional. Built against v0.9.1.16

Base URLs:

* <a href="http://localhost:5000">http://localhost:5000</a>

License: <a href="https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita/blob/develop/LICENSE">GPL-3.0</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (AuthKey)
    - Parameter Name: **x-api-key**, in: header. Auth Key authentication. Enter your Auth key from your user settings

<h1 id="kavita-account">Account</h1>

All Account matters

## Returns true if OIDC authentication cookies are present and the Kavita.Server.Extensions.IdentityServiceExtensions.OpenIdConnect scheme has been registered

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/oidc-authenticated \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /api/Account/oidc-authenticated`

Makes no guarantee about their validity

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
true
```

<h3 id="returns-true-if-oidc-authentication-cookies-are-present-and-the-kavitaserverextensionsidentityserviceextensionsopenidconnect-scheme-has-been-registered-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
AuthKey
</aside>

## Remove the OIDC link for the authenticated user. This action will also remove the authentication cookie. The caller should take note and redirect to login if no other authentication is currently present (I.e. JWT)

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/clear-oidc-link \
  -X POST \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /api/Account/clear-oidc-link`

<h3 id="remove-the-oidc-link-for-the-authenticated-user-this-action-will-also-remove-the-authentication-cookie-the-caller-should-take-note-and-redirect-to-login-if-no-other-authentication-is-currently-present-ie-jwt-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
AuthKey
</aside>

## Returns the current user, as it would from login

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /api/Account`

Does not return tokens for the user

## Update a user's password

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/reset-password \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "userName": "string",
    "password": "string",
    "oldPassword": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/reset-password`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "userName": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "oldPassword": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-users-password-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ResetPasswordDto](#schemaresetpassworddto)|false|none|
|» userName|body|string|true|none|
|» password|body|string|true|none|
|» oldPassword|body|string \| null|false|none|

<h3 id="update-a-users-password-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
AuthKey
</aside>

## Register the first user (admin) on the server. Will not do anything if an admin is already confirmed

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/register \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "username": "string",
    "email": "string",
    "password": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/register`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "username": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "password": "string"
}
```

|body|body|[RegisterDto](#schemaregisterdto)|false|none|
|» username|body|string|true|none|
|» email|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» password|body|string|true|none|

## Perform a login. Will send JWT Token of the logged in user back.

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/login \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "username": "string",
    "password": "string",
    "apiKey": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/login`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "apiKey": "string"
}
```

|» apiKey|body|string \| null|false|none|

## Refreshes the user's JWT token

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/refresh-token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "token": "string",
    "refreshToken": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/refresh-token`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "refreshToken": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="refreshes-the-users-jwt-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TokenRequestDto](#schematokenrequestdto)|false|none|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» refreshToken|body|string \| null|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "refreshToken": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[TokenRequestDto](#schematokenrequestdto)|

AuthKey
</aside>

```bash
  -d '{
    "email": "string",
```

```json
  "email": "string",
  "password": "string"
}
```

## Change the Age Rating restriction for the user

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/update/age-restriction \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "ageRating": 0,
    "includeUnknowns": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/update/age-restriction`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ageRating": 0,
  "includeUnknowns": true
}
```

<h3 id="change-the-age-rating-restriction-for-the-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[UpdateAgeRestrictionDto](#schemaupdateagerestrictiondto)|false|none|
|» ageRating|body|[AgeRating](#schemaagerating)|true|Members:<br>- `0` — Unknown<br>- `1` — Rating Pending (RatingPending)<br>- `2` — Early Childhood (EarlyChildhood)<br>- `3` — Everyone<br>- `4` — G<br>- `5` — Everyone 10+ (Everyone10Plus)<br>- `6` — PG<br>- `7` — Kids to Adults (KidsToAdults)<br>- `8` — Teen<br>- `9` — MA15+ (Mature15Plus)<br>- `10` — Mature 17+ (Mature17Plus)<br>- `11` — M (Mature)<br>- `12` — R18+ (R18Plus)<br>- `13` — Adults Only 18+ (AdultsOnly)<br>- `14` — X18+ (X18Plus)<br>- `-1` — Not Applicable (NotApplicable)|
|» includeUnknowns|body|boolean|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» ageRating|0|
|» ageRating|1|
|» ageRating|2|
|» ageRating|3|
|» ageRating|4|
|» ageRating|5|
|» ageRating|6|
|» ageRating|7|
|» ageRating|8|
|» ageRating|9|
|» ageRating|10|
|» ageRating|11|
|» ageRating|12|
|» ageRating|13|
|» ageRating|14|
|» ageRating|-1|

<h3 id="change-the-age-rating-restriction-for-the-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
AuthKey
</aside>

## Update the user account. This can only affect Username, Email (will require confirming), Roles, and Library access.

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Account/update \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "userId": 0,
    "username": "string",
    "roles": [
      "string"
    ],
    "libraries": [
      0
    ],
    "ageRestriction": {
      "ageRating": 0,
      "includeUnknowns": true
    },
    "email": "string",
    "identityProvider": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/Account/update`

Users who's Kavita.Models.Entities.User.AppUser.IdentityProvider is not Kavita.Models.Entities.Enums.IdentityProvider.Kavita cannot be edited if Kavita.Models.DTOs.Settings.OidcConfigDto.SyncUserSettings is true

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "userId": 0,
  "username": "string",
  "roles": [
    "string"
  ],
  "libraries": [
    0
  ],
  "ageRestriction": {
    "ageRating": 0,
    "includeUnknowns": true
  },
  "email": "string",
  "identityProvider": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-user-account-this-can-only-affect-username-email-will-require-confirming-roles-and-library-access-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[UpdateUserDto](#schemaupdateuserdto)|false|none|
|» userId|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» roles|body|[string]|false|none|
|» libraries|body|[integer(int32)]|false|none|
|» ageRestriction|body|[AgeRestrictionDto](#schemaagerestrictiondto)|false|none|
|» email|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» identityProvider|body|[IdentityProvider](#schemaidentityprovider)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Kavita<br>- `1` — OpenID Connect (OpenIdConnect)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» identityProvider|0|
|» identityProvider|1|

## Removes a Chapter

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Chapter \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /api/Chapter`

<h3 id="removes-a-chapter-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chapterId|query|integer(int32)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
true
```

<h3 id="removes-a-chapter-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
AuthKey
</aside>

## Deletes multiple chapters and any volumes with no leftover chapters

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Chapter/delete-multiple \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "chapterIds": [
      0
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/Chapter/delete-multiple`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "chapterIds": [
    0
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-multiple-chapters-and-any-volumes-with-no-leftover-chapters-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|seriesId|query|integer(int32)|false|The ID of the series|
|body|body|[DeleteChaptersDto](#schemadeletechaptersdto)|false|The IDs of the chapters to be deleted|
|» chapterIds|body|[integer(int32)]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
true
```

## Removes a font family from the system. The family is validated for in-use server side and only removed when it is not selected by a user, or when an admin forces the deletion.

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Font \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /api/Font`

<h3 id="removes-a-font-family-from-the-system-the-family-is-validated-for-in-use-server-side-and-only-removed-when-it-is-not-selected-by-a-user-or-when-an-admin-forces-the-deletion-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fontId|query|integer(int32)|false|Any file within the family to delete|
|force|query|boolean|false|If the family is in use and an admin wants it deleted, they must confirm to force delete it. This is prompted in the UI.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "deleted": true,
  "inUse": true
}
```

<h3 id="removes-a-font-family-from-the-system-the-family-is-validated-for-in-use-server-side-and-only-removed-when-it-is-not-selected-by-a-user-or-when-an-admin-forces-the-deletion-responses">Responses</h3>

<h1 id="kavita-kavitaplusaudit">KavitaPlusAudit</h1>

## Returns a paged, filtered list of all Kavita+ audit events. Admin only.

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/kavita-plus-audit/entries \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "category": 0,
    "status": 0,
    "subjectType": 0,
    "provider": 0,
    "userId": 0,
    "seriesId": 0,
    "fromUtc": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "toUtc": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "search": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/kavita-plus-audit/entries`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "category": 0,
  "status": 0,
  "subjectType": 0,
  "provider": 0,
  "userId": 0,
  "seriesId": 0,
  "fromUtc": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "toUtc": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "search": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="returns-a-paged-filtered-list-of-all-kavita-audit-events-admin-only-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|PageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|PageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|body|body|[KavitaPlusAuditFilterDto](#schemakavitaplusauditfilterdto)|false|none|
|» category|body|[KavitaPlusAuditCategory](#schemakavitaplusauditcategory)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Match<br>- `1` — Metadata<br>- `2` — Scrobble<br>- `3` — Sync<br>- `4` — System|
|» status|body|[AuditStatus](#schemaauditstatus)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Success<br>- `1` — Failure<br>- `2` — Info|
|» subjectType|body|[AuditSubjectType](#schemaauditsubjecttype)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Series<br>- `1` — Person<br>- `2` — Collection<br>- `3` — Chapter<br>- `4` — Global<br>- `5` — Volume|
|» provider|body|[ScrobbleProvider](#schemascrobbleprovider)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Kavita<br>- `1` — AniList<br>- `2` — Mal<br>- `4` — Cbr<br>- `5` — Hardcover<br>- `6` — MangaBaka|
|» userId|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» seriesId|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» fromUtc|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» toUtc|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» search|body|string \| null|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» category|0|
|» category|1|
|» category|2|
|» category|3|
|» category|4|
|» status|0|
|» status|1|
|» status|2|
|» subjectType|0|
|» subjectType|1|
|» subjectType|2|
|» subjectType|3|
|» subjectType|4|
|» subjectType|5|
|» provider|0|
|» provider|1|
|» provider|2|
|» provider|4|
|» provider|5|
|» provider|6|

<h1 id="kavita-oauth">OAuth</h1>

## Start the OAuth flow for the given upstream, redirect (302!) to KavitaPlus

```bash
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|upstream|query|[OAuthUpstream](#schemaoauthupstream)|false|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|upstream|0|
|upstream|1|
|upstream|2|
|upstream|3|
|upstream|4|

## Merges Persons into one, this action is irreversible

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Person/merge \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "destId": 0,
    "srcId": 0
  }'
```

```json

  "destId": 0,
  "srcId": 0
}
```

## Ensure the alias is valid to be added. For example, the alias cannot be on another person or be the same as the current person name/alias.

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Person/valid-alias \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "personId": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "alias": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/Person/valid-alias`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "personId": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "alias": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

|» name|body|string|true|none|

```json
true
```

<h1 id="kavita-plugin">Plugin</h1>

## Authenticate with the Server given an auth key. This will log you in by returning the user object and the JWT token.

> Code samples

```bash

  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /api/Plugin/authenticate`

This API is not fully built out and may require more information in later releases


|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string|false|String to parse|
|libraryType|query|[LibraryType](#schemalibrarytype)|false|Determines the set of pattern matching to use|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|libraryType|0|
|libraryType|1|
|libraryType|2|
|libraryType|3|
|libraryType|4|
|libraryType|5|

```json
  "seriesName": "string",
  "seriesYear": "string",
  "minChapterNumber": 0,
  "maxChapterNumber": 0,
  "minVolumeNumber": 0,
  "maxVolumeNumber": 0
}
```

## post/api/Plugin/parse-bulk

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Plugin/parse-bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "names": [
      "string"
    ],
    "libraryType": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/Plugin/parse-bulk`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "names": [
    "string"
  ],
  "libraryType": 0
}
```

<h3 id="postapipluginparse-bulk-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ParseBulkRequestDto](#schemaparsebulkrequestdto)|false|none|
|» names|body|[string]|false|none|
|» libraryType|body|[LibraryType](#schemalibrarytype)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Manga<br>- `1` — Comic (Flexible) (Comic)<br>- `2` — Book<br>- `3` — Image<br>- `4` — Light Novel (LightNovel)<br>- `5` — Comic (ComicVine)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» libraryType|0|
|» libraryType|1|
|» libraryType|2|
|» libraryType|3|
|» libraryType|4|
|» libraryType|5|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "results": {
    "property1": {
      "seriesName": "string",
      "seriesYear": "string",
      "minChapterNumber": 0,
      "maxChapterNumber": 0,

      "maxVolumeNumber": 0
    },

      "seriesName": "string",

  },
```

<h1 id="kavita-series">Series</h1>

## Gets series with the applied Filter

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Series/v2 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "id": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "statements": [
      {
        "comparison": 0,
        "field": 0,
        "value": "string"
      }
    ],
    "combination": 0,
    "sortOptions": {
      "sortField": 1,
      "isAscending": true
    },
    "entityType": 0,
    "limitTo": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/Series/v2`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "statements": [
    {
      "comparison": 0,
      "field": 0,
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "combination": 0,
  "sortOptions": {
    "sortField": 1,
    "isAscending": true
  },
  "entityType": 0,
  "limitTo": 0
}
```

<h3 id="gets-series-with-the-applied-filter-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|PageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|PageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|body|body|[SeriesFilterV2Dto](#schemaseriesfilterv2dto)|false|none|
|» id|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» statements|body|[[SeriesFilterStatementDto](#schemaseriesfilterstatementdto)]|false|none|
|» combination|body|[FilterCombination](#schemafiltercombination)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Or<br>- `1` — And|
|» sortOptions|body|[SeriesSortOptionDto](#schemaseriessortoptiondto)|false|none|
|» entityType|body|[FilterEntityType](#schemafilterentitytype)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Series<br>- `1` — Reading List (ReadingList)<br>- `2` — Person<br>- `3` — Annotation|
|» limitTo|body|integer(int32)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» combination|0|
|» combination|1|
|» entityType|0|
|» entityType|1|
|» entityType|2|
|» entityType|3|

## Deletes multiple series from Kavita at once

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Series/delete-multiple \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "seriesIds": [
      0
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/Series/delete-multiple`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "seriesIds": [
    0
  ]
}
```

## Updates the Series

```bash
  -d '{

    "localizedNameLocked": true,
```

## Fetches the related series for a given series

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Series/related \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /api/Series/related`

<h3 id="fetches-the-related-series-for-a-given-series-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|seriesId|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|relation|query|[RelationKind](#schemarelationkind)|false|Type of Relationship to pull back|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|relation|1|
|relation|2|
|relation|3|
|relation|4|
|relation|5|
|relation|6|
|relation|7|
|relation|8|
|relation|9|
|relation|10|
|relation|11|
|relation|12|
|relation|13|
|relation|14|
|relation|16|

## Returns all related series against the passed series Id

## Returns external series metadata around a Given External Series

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Series/external-series-detail \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /api/Series/external-series-detail`

## This will perform the fix match

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/Series/update-match \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "malId": 0,
    "aniListId": 0,
    "mangabakaId": 0,
    "mangaBakaEditionId": "string",
    "hardcoverId": 0,
    "isStandAlone": true,
    "cbrId": 0,
    "seriesName": "string",
    "localizedSeriesName": "string",
    "plusMediaFormat": 1
  }'
```

```json
{
  "malId": 0,
  "aniListId": 0,
  "mangabakaId": 0,
  "mangaBakaEditionId": "string",
  "hardcoverId": 0,
  "isStandAlone": true,
  "cbrId": 0,
  "seriesName": "string",
  "localizedSeriesName": "string",
  "plusMediaFormat": 1
}
```

|» aniListId|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|

|» mangaBakaEditionId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» hardcoverId|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» isStandAlone|body|boolean|false|none|
|» cbrId|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» seriesName|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» localizedSeriesName|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» plusMediaFormat|body|[PlusMediaFormat](#schemaplusmediaformat)|false|Members:<br>- `1` — Manga<br>- `2` — Comic<br>- `3` — LightNovel<br>- `4` — Book<br>- `5` — Unknown|

## Returns all users with tokens registered and their token information. Does not send the tokens.

```json
        "provider": 0,
        "validUntilUtc": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"

]
```

<h1 id="kavita-wanttoread">WantToRead</h1>

Responsible for all things Want To Read

## Return all Series that are in the current logged in user's Want to Read list, filtered

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5000/api/want-to-read/v2 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "id": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "statements": [
      {
        "comparison": 0,
        "field": 0,
        "value": "string"
      }
    ],
    "combination": 0,
    "sortOptions": {
      "sortField": 1,
      "isAscending": true
    },
    "entityType": 0,
    "limitTo": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/want-to-read/v2`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "statements": [
    {
      "comparison": 0,
      "field": 0,
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "combination": 0,
  "sortOptions": {
    "sortField": 1,
    "isAscending": true
  },
  "entityType": 0,
  "limitTo": 0
}
```

<h3 id="return-all-series-that-are-in-the-current-logged-in-users-want-to-read-list-filtered-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|PageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|PageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|userId|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional user id to request the OnDeck for someone else. They must have profile sharing enabled when doing so|
|body|body|[SeriesFilterV2Dto](#schemaseriesfilterv2dto)|false|none|
|» id|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» statements|body|[[SeriesFilterStatementDto](#schemaseriesfilterstatementdto)]|false|none|
|» combination|body|[FilterCombination](#schemafiltercombination)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Or<br>- `1` — And|
|» sortOptions|body|[SeriesSortOptionDto](#schemaseriessortoptiondto)|false|none|
|» entityType|body|[FilterEntityType](#schemafilterentitytype)|false|Members:<br>- `0` — Series<br>- `1` — Reading List (ReadingList)<br>- `2` — Person<br>- `3` — Annotation|
|» limitTo|body|integer(int32)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» combination|0|
|» combination|1|
|» entityType|0|
|» entityType|1|
|» entityType|2|
|» entityType|3|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "originalName": "string",
    "localizedName": "string",
    "sortName": "string",
```
